description: What are the basic facts of this chain (CAIP-2 id, gas token, explorer, x402/MPP settlement, stablecoins)? Paid ($0.001 USDC): Cited chain facts from a prepared dataset: CAIP-2 chain id, gas token, finality class, block explorer, whether x402 and MPP settle there, and stablecoins. Fields not established from a source are the string "unknown". Unknown chains and malformed input return 404/400 and are never charged. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://payments-intel-production.up.railway.app/v1/chain. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL. Paid: $0.001 per call (x402/MPP).

chain.description: Chain slug, name or CAIP-2 id, e.g. base, solana, eip155:8453
